node_definition.done_when: Both live prompt sites in reckon/crew/prompts.py are rewritten to state the rule the gate applies, taken from reckon/crew/promotion.py's control-gate reader (read it before writing): the NEGATIVE_CONTROL_DECLARED_RULE constant and the negative_control_log line of the manifest template, which is otherwise left exactly as it is, bare EXIT= requirement included. The declared mutation is still shown to the worker and still named on the node record, as something the worker applies and a reader compares against, not a string any gate matches. No other prompt text changes. The tests that pin the old wording (tests/test_gate_log_names_its_tree.py, tests/test_negative_control_log_is_a_path.py, tests/test_crew_negative_control_header.py and tests/test_brief_prompt.py) are updated only where they assert the verbatim sentence, and a new tests/test_the_prompt_teaches_the_rule_the_gate_applies.py asserts that neither site says verbatim or asks that the first line repeat the mutation, and that both name the exit line and the failing-id requirement. The named negative control (restore the old sentence at either site) reddens the new test. The gate is those five files plus tests/test_worker_prompt_contract.py, run at base and at head. Each arm is recorded as JSON carrying completed true and a literal command with absolute paths and no angle-bracket placeholder; each log names its revision on the first line and ends with a bare line reading EXIT= followed by the exit code. Every pytest process uses a basetemp private to that process. The head arm adds no failure id other than the old-wording assertions it deliberately changed, each named; any other added id means status blocked. ruff check and ruff format --check over the changed paths report no finding the base did not. Scratch goes under /tmp in a directory named for this run and is deleted before status complete. An evidence fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/crew-runtime-positive-controls/the-prompt-teaches-the-rule-the-gate-applies.html records the change. The turn ends once the manifest reads complete or blocked.
